label: MARKETING TERM
headline: Niche Marketing
body: This is focusing your marketing efforts on a small, specific group of people with unique needs or interests.
caption:
Instead of selling "art supplies" to everyone, a niche might be "watercolor supplies for urban sketchers." This helps you speak directly to your ideal customers, making your messages more relevant and effective. When you understand your niche deeply, you can create products and services they truly need. Think about who you serve best!
